items: Local SEO puts your restaurant in front of nearby people who are ready to eat, and the Map Pack at the top of Google results is where most of those clicks go.
Your Google Business Profile matters most, so complete every field, keep name, address and phone consistent everywhere, pick accurate categories, add your menu and update hours and photos.
Google weighs review quality, quantity and recency, so ask for reviews right after a good meal and reply to both positive and negative ones briefly and personally.
Give each location its own landing page, earn local backlinks through directories, food bloggers and community coverage, and track your Map Pack positions to see what's working.
